description: THE FREE TIER — what anyone gets on Rokha each UTC day, read from the one definition the gates enforce. Free, no account: talk to Rokha (10 questions a day — the same taste signed in) and read everything public — the Market, every listing, public runs and traces, finished hunts and saved marks, the Windsock board; no runs without an account (sign in free); no builds, hunts, marks or web searches without the Lab. Free, signed in: 10 questions a day, 5 runs a day (tool steps on Rokha's sandbox, model steps on your own model key), and listing — claim a page and publish 1 agent, 3 rigs, 2 MCP servers and 3 plain skills in all; no builds, Hunts or Mark Checks without the Lab; more runs: a run pack, 100 runs for $1, or the Lab. The Lab — the Lab month ($29.99 — card, USDC, SOL or $ROKHA) or holding 1M $ROKHA — full access to everything, the runtime and Windsock intel included: 300 runs, 50 Hunts and 100 Mark Checks a day, no publish caps, every model step on your own model key. Every refusal names both doors. Answers the same day as data under `per_day`; signed in, your own questions and runs left. Public, no login. REST twin: GET /api/free-tier (signed in: GET /api/free-tier/me)
